BUILD_TAG.description: Overrides the build tag that /info reports.

CONFIGHUB_ADMIN_OPERATOR.description: Who to record as having run an admin command, such as suspending a user. Falls back to USER.

CONFIGHUB_AUTH_ISSUER.description: External identity provider issuer. Setting it turns on RFC 8693 token exchange (POST /auth/exchange).

CONFIGHUB_DEBUG.description: Above 0 turns on debug logging, which includes failed SQL queries; 2 also logs every SQL query.

CONFIGHUB_EVENT_LOG_PRUNE_INTERVAL.description: How often the event log is pruned, as a Go duration. 0 turns pruning off.

CONFIGHUB_EVENT_LOG_RETENTION.description: How long event log entries are kept, as a Go duration.

CONFIGHUB_FILTER_QUERY_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit on each statement of a read whose where clause the caller chose, as a Go duration. 0 turns the limit off.

CONFIGHUB_IDP_ROLE_CLAIM.description: Token claim organization roles are read from. Only realm_access.roles is accepted; it is still read so existing deployments keep starting.

CONFIGHUB_LOCAL_ADMIN_JWK.description: Public key, as a JWK, of the local administrator. Setting it bootstraps the local organization and administrator. A public key, not a secret.

CONFIGHUB_MIGRATIONS.description: Directory to read migrations from. Defaults to the migrations directory of the source tree the binary was built from.

CONFIGHUB_OAUTHCLIENT_QUOTA.description: Number of OAuth clients each organization may register.

CONFIGHUB_OAUTHCLIENT_TRUSTED_ORGS.description: Comma-separated organization IDs that are first-party: they may register OAuth clients for all organizations and are exempt from the quota.

CONFIGHUB_QUOTA_ENABLED.description: Refuse to create an entity that would take its Organization's count of that type past the quota's Max. The counts are kept either way, so turning it on later enforces the quotas against the entities that already exist.

CONFIGHUB_SUSPENSION_REFRESH_INTERVAL.description: How often the set of suspended users is reloaded, as a Go duration. 0 stops reloading after startup; for tests, not production.

CONFIGHUB_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_AUDIENCE.description: Audience /auth/exchange requires. Registered OAuth clients are configured to emit it.

CONFIGHUB_TOKEN_SIGNING_KEY_JWK.description: JWT signing key, as a JWK. Unset, a key is generated per process, so sessions end at restart and replicas reject each other's tokens. Secret. Keep it stable: changing it ends every session signed with the old key.

CONFIGHUB_UI_URL.description: http or https URL of this instance's web UI, when it is not served on the server's own host.

CONFIGHUB_UPLOAD_PULL_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETW.description: Allow upload pulls from registries on private and loopback addresses, and from a loopback registry over plain HTTP. Never set it on a server that pulls for users of other organizations.

CONFIGHUB_USER_TOKEN_MAX_LIFETIME.description: How far ahead a user token's expiry may be set, as a Go duration such as 8760h; it also forbids tokens that never expire. Unset means no limit.

DATABASE_URL.description: Full PostgreSQL connection string. When set, the DB_* variables are not used. Secret: it carries the database password. Change the password in PostgreSQL first, or the server cannot connect.

DB_HOST.description: Database host, used when DATABASE_URL is unset.

DB_NAME.description: Database name, used when DATABASE_URL is unset.

DB_PORT.description: Database port, used when DATABASE_URL is unset.

DB_USER.description: Database user, used when DATABASE_URL is unset.

ENABLE_OCI_SERVER.description: Run the OCI registry server. false turns it off.

INSTANCE_ID.description: This instance's ID, for access control per instance. Unset turns that access control off.

JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_JWK.description: Deprecated name for CONFIGHUB_TOKEN_SIGNING_KEY_JWK, read only when that is unset. Secret.

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Keycloak admin password, not consulted when KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY_JWK is set. Secret.

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Keycloak admin user, not consulted when KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY_JWK is set.

KEYCLOAK_AUTH_URL.description: Keycloak's public URL. Unset together with KEYCLOAK_REALM to run without an identity provider.

KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY_JWK.description: Signing key, as a JWK, that replaces both the client secret and the admin password. Secret. Its public half is registered on the client in Keycloak, so change both together.

KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The server's Keycloak client secret. Secret. It must match the client's secret in Keycloak, so change both together.

KEYCLOAK_DEVICE_CLIENT_ID.description: Keycloak client ID for the device authorization flow.

KEYCLOAK_INTERNAL_URL.description: URL the server reaches Keycloak at, when it differs from KEYCLOAK_AUTH_URL.

KEYCLOAK_REALM.description: Keycloak realm. Unset together with KEYCLOAK_AUTH_URL to run without an identity provider.

OCI_EXTERNAL_HOST.description: Advanced: overrides the host of OCI_EXTERNAL_URL. Registry host advertised to clients. Defaults to the host of OCI_EXTERNAL_URL, or else oci.<request host>, or the request host itself when it is an IP address or localhost.

OCI_EXTERNAL_PORT.description: Advanced: overrides the port of OCI_EXTERNAL_URL. Registry port advertised to clients. Defaults to the port of OCI_EXTERNAL_URL or its scheme's, or else 443 over https and 9092 otherwise.

OCI_EXTERNAL_URL.description: http or https URL clients reach the registry at, like https://oci.example.com or https://oci.example.com:8443. The advertised host, port and scheme, and the token realm (<URL>/token), come from it. Unset, they are worked out from each request.

OCI_PORT.description: Port the OCI registry server listens on.

OCI_SERVICE_NAME.description: Service name in the registry's WWW-Authenticate challenge.

OCI_TOKEN_REALM.description: Advanced: token realm in the registry's WWW-Authenticate challenge. Defaults to <registry URL>/token, the registry advertised to clients, when OCI_EXTERNAL_URL or OCI_EXTERNAL_HOST is set, or else <scheme>://<request host>/token.

OCI_TRUST_FORWARDED_HOST.description: Read the request host for the registry's advertised address and token realm from X-Forwarded-Host or Forwarded: host= instead of Host, when they come from a loopback, link-local or private address. Set it only behind a proxy that overwrites those headers rather than passing a client's through.

PORT.description: Port the API server listens on.

RDS_IAM_AUTH.description: Authenticate to the database with RDS IAM. The AWS SDK then reads its standard variables, such as AWS_REGION and AWS_ROLE_ARN.
